title: The Runaway Bride
logline: A reluctant bride hires a pilot to help her escape her own lavish wedding because her fiancé is actually an undercover corporate spy.

roles.description: Wearing a massive, highly impractical dress, completely panicked.
Polished, incredibly handsome, constantly checking their comms.
A ridiculously opulent orbital cathedral floating in zero-G.
A high-end guild that plans weddings and enforces prenuptial agreements.
A heavily armed corporate gunship masquerading as a VIP transport.

public_situation: The {role:matrimony_syndicate} is hosting the sector's most expensive wedding at the {role:wedding_chapel}.
private_truth: The bride discovered her fiancé is a corporate spy planning to assassinate her father during the reception to trigger a hostile takeover.

beats.public_change: The fiancé realizes the bride is missing from her dressing room.

missions.reason: The fiancé hires the pilot to buy and quietly deliver micro-tracking tags to the chapel's security team to find the bride.
missions.private_fact: The pilot realizes the tags are military-grade target painters.

beats.public_change: The syndicate locks down the chapel, trapping the guests inside.

missions.reason: The fiancé asks the pilot to run a deep biometric scan of the chapel to locate the bride's unique heartbeat.
missions.private_fact: The pilot finds the bride hiding inside a massive hollow ice sculpture.

beats.public_change: The fiancé orders his private gunship to blockade the chapel's launch tubes so no one can leave.

missions.reason: The bride begs the pilot to destroy the gunship blockading the launch tubes so she can flee in her personal shuttle.
missions.private_fact: The fiancé is aboard the gunship and will hail the pilot mid-fight with a massive bribe to stand down.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the gunship, allowing the bride to escape.
resolutions.summary: The bride escapes and exposes the assassination plot. Her father survives, the fiancé is arrested, and the syndicate is deeply embarrassed.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot ruined a high-society wedding to save a bride from a corporate assassin.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the fiancé's offer and spares the gunship.
resolutions.summary: The fiancé finds the bride. The wedding proceeds, and the father is quietly poisoned during the toast. The fiancé takes over the company.
The syndicate guards find the bride freezing inside the ice sculpture. She is forced to go through with the wedding.

loose_threads.detail: The fiancé's handler isn't a corporate executive; it's actually the bride's own mother.
The fiancé complains that the matrimony syndicate charged him triple for "assassination cleanup" fees.

radio_hooks: Sector's most expensive wedding delayed by "technical issues".
{role:jilted_fiance} reassures guests the ceremony will proceed.

voice_direction.reluctant_bride: Fast-talking, trembling, incredibly bossy despite the panic.
